execution_overview.overall_summary: Executed both planned tasks in Python inside Docker. Task1 (multimethod) and Task2 (paired t-test with 90% node bootstrap) both completed successfully. Results show substantially lower ASPL for the high-openness group and a large negative paired t-statistic, supporting the focal claim.

method_fidelity.fidelity_note: Followed the planned multimethod path (Approach 1, 2, 3). Data and modeling choices (median split, cosine similarity, planar filtering, 90% node bootstrap) were preserved as planned.

result_raw.result_text: High-openness group shows lower ASPL than low-openness group with a large negative paired t-statistic (p≈0).

conclusion.conclusion_text: The result strongly supports the claim that the high-openness group’s semantic network has lower ASPL than the low-openness group’s network.
